name: Default
shortDescription: Real-time, local speech-to-text server with a browser transcription UI, a WebSocket streaming API and an OpenAI-compatible REST API, running Whisper on the CPU.

alerts.message: Transcription requires the generated WLK_API_TOKEN. In the web UI, open the settings and append ?token=<WLK_API_TOKEN> to the WebSocket URL before recording; API clients send it as an Authorization: Bearer header. Browsers only allow the microphone over HTTPS.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
